lines.hanzi: 你好！我很想你。你最近忙不忙？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ hěn xiǎng nǐ. Nǐ zuìjìn máng bu máng?
lines.english: Hello! I miss you. Have you been busy lately?

lines.hanzi: 我现在在北京工作。这里的人很多，天气也冷。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài Běijīng gōngzuò. Zhèlǐ de rén hěn duō, tiānqì yě lěng.
lines.english: I work in Beijing now. There are many people here, and the weather is cold too.

lines.hanzi: 我的中文老师叫李老师。她教得很好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī jiào Lǐ lǎoshī. Tā jiāo de hěn hǎo.
lines.english: My Chinese teacher is Teacher Li. She teaches very well.

lines.hanzi: 我每天学习两个小时。现在会说、会写了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān xuéxí liǎng gè xiǎoshí. Xiànzài huì shuō, huì xiě le.
lines.english: I study two hours every day. Now I can speak and write.

lines.hanzi: 下个月我回上海。我们一起吃饭、喝茶好吗？
lines.pinyin: Xià gè yuè wǒ huí Shànghǎi. Wǒmen yīqǐ chīfàn, hē chá hǎo ma?
lines.english: Next month I'll return to Shanghai. Shall we eat and drink tea together?

lines.hanzi: 祝你身体健康，工作顺利！
lines.pinyin: Zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng, gōngzuò shùnlì!
lines.english: Wishing you good health and smooth work!
